thread:
nora: Need a playbook thread for next month's webinar. Goal: 1) drive Dedicated trial signups, 2) collect signal for messaging iteration (which headline resonates). Want to A/B test two registration funnels. Thoughts? :bulb:
ben: Love it. Two funnels = Narrative-led vs Numbers-led. Narrative: focus on customer story + patterns. Numbers: bench slide + cost savings. We'll A/B test subject line + hero headline + 1 social creative each.
sam: Suggest we also split CTAs: Trial signups vs Demo request. Track downstream conversion. Use `creative_arm` param in URLs.
lina: For abstracts I propose short copy variants — dropping drafts:
A (Narrative): "How Product Teams Ship Predictable LLM Features" — story + playbook
B (Numbers): "Cut Inference Token Cost by 30% Without Raising Latency" — data-led
Which to use on hero depends on the audience cohort.
nora: Good. We'll route enterprise-looking signups to Demo flow, self-serve signups to Trial. HubSpot property `company_size` + `email_domain` used to decide. ben: Also add a pre-event micro-survey question: "primary pain: latency/cost/quality/other" so we can personalize email followups.
sam: Run-of-show (50m):
```
00:00-05:00 host welcome + poll (micro-survey results shown)
05:00-20:00 keynote: patterns + 1 customer vignette
20:00-30:00 benchmark demo (before/after cost + latency)
30:00-45:00 moderated Qs + live audience prompts
45:00-50:00 CTA + trial link + next steps
```
lina: Rehearsal plan: full tech + host + 1 producer 48h before. Ops-bot, can you reserve Tue 9am PT and Thu 4pm PT for rehearsal?
ops-bot: calendar-helper: Tue 9am PT and Thu 4pm PT reserved. Webinar platform requires a 20-min test stream 24h prior. Also recommending upload fallback video and pre-signed URL to CDN.
ben: Marketing cadence: teaser (2w out) -> speaker reveal + benchmark tease (1w) -> social creative variants 5 days -> reminder 1 day -> 1h before final. We'll A/B the LinkedIn copy and track `creative_arm`.
sam: Measurement plan: track HubSpot events `registered`, `attended_live`, `clicked_trial`, `clicked_demo`, `watched_recording`. Add GTM event `creative_click` for ad variants. We'll report lift by arm at D+3.
lina: Speaker assets: 1-slide bio, 2 benchmark slides, 1 fallback slide (CLI + recording link). Ask speakers for 2-line bio + headshot by Mon.
nora: Inbound routing: implement HubSpot workflow: if `company_size` >=100 AND `creative_arm` == "numbers" -> assign to AE queue, else send trial CTA nurture. Also create a follow-up email variant personalized with their micro-survey pain.
ben: For messaging iteration: after webinar, run a 3-way chi-sq test across headline, social creative, and CTA to see what moved trial signups. Push learnings into next landing page.
sam: Ops notes: include a short script for stream failure: `if stream fails -> switch to fallback video -> host continues Q&A`. Also enable recording and captions.
nora: OK action items:
- ben: build creative variants + social plan by Fri
- lina: final abstracts + registration copy by Fri
- sam: HubSpot workflows + tracking events by Mon
- ops-bot: reserve rehearsal + upload fallback video by Tue
I'll compile run sheet once assets arrive. Thanks :sparkles:
